content_html:
Car accessories are easy to overspend on because many products promise to make driving safer, easier or more convenient without delivering much real-world benefit. The better purchases are usually the items that solve a specific problem: getting you moving after a flat battery, helping diagnose a warning light, keeping tires correctly inflated or recording what happens on the road.

This guide focuses on seven motoring products that can genuinely earn their place in your car or garage. We have deliberately avoided relying on one-off sale prices because eBay.com prices and availability change constantly; the links below take you to current listings so you can compare brands, specifications, seller feedback and warranty terms before buying.

Quick list: the car accessories and garage tools worth checking

  • Portable jump starter: one of the most useful emergency items to keep charged in the car.
  • Dash cam: useful for recording incidents and unexpected events on the road.
  • OBD2 scanner: a practical way to read many diagnostic trouble codes before paying for workshop investigation.
  • Portable tire inflator: convenient for maintaining tire pressure at home or on the road.
  • Battery charger or maintainer: particularly useful for cars that are driven infrequently.
  • Wireless CarPlay or Android Auto adapter: a simple convenience upgrade for compatible wired systems.
  • Dual-action car polisher: a worthwhile garage tool for drivers who regularly detail their own cars.

1. Portable jump starter — best emergency car purchase

A modern lithium jump starter can be far easier to use than traditional jumper cables because you do not need a second vehicle. Keep one properly charged and it can provide a useful backup when a 12-volt battery does not have enough power to start the engine.

Current eBay listings include compact units from established automotive brands as well as many lower-cost generic products. The headline peak-amp figure is not the only thing that matters. Compatibility with your engine size, clamp quality, safety protections, operating temperature and the quality of the internal battery are more important than choosing the biggest number printed on the box.

What to look for: clear gas/diesel engine-size guidance, reverse-polarity protection, short-circuit protection, strong clamps, USB-C charging where available, a useful storage case and a reputable seller. Check the unit every few months rather than leaving it forgotten in the trunk for years.

Compare current portable jump starters on eBay

2. Dash cam — best for everyday peace of mind

A dash cam cannot prevent an accident, but having a clear video record can be useful when there is disagreement about what happened. eBay has a very broad dash-cam market, from basic front-facing units to dual-channel front-and-rear systems and higher-end cameras with parking modes.

Do not choose on advertised resolution alone. Image processing, low-light performance, field of view and number-plate clarity can vary significantly between cameras that make similar claims. A reliable memory card and sensible installation are also essential.

What to look for: at least 1080p recording from a recognizable brand, good nighttime footage, loop recording, a supercapacitor design if the car sees very hot summers, and an optional hardwire kit if you want parking-mode recording. Check local rules before positioning a camera or running cables around airbags.

Compare current front and rear dash cams on eBay

3. OBD2 scanner — best garage tool for understanding warning lights

An OBD2 scanner can help you understand why the check-engine light has appeared by reading diagnostic trouble codes from compatible vehicles. eBay Motors has everything from simple handheld code readers to professional-style bidirectional scan tools covering multiple vehicle systems.

For most home users, an expensive workshop-grade scanner is unnecessary. A basic reader that displays and clears standard engine codes may be enough. More advanced buyers may want live data, ABS and airbag coverage, service resets or manufacturer-specific diagnostics.

What to look for: support for your exact vehicle and model year, the systems you actually want to diagnose, free versus paid software updates, clear English-language documentation and a seller with a strong track record. Avoid assuming that every scanner can access every control module simply because it plugs into the OBD2 port.

Compare current OBD2 scanners and code readers on eBay

4. Portable tire inflator — best small tool for routine maintenance

Correct tire pressure matters for predictable handling, tire wear and fuel economy, yet it is one of the easiest maintenance checks to neglect. A portable inflator makes it much easier to check and correct pressures at home instead of relying on a gas-station compressor.

You can choose between compact battery-powered inflators and 12-volt units that plug into the vehicle. Cordless models are more convenient, while a good wired compressor can make sense if you value long running time and do not want another battery to keep charged.

What to look for: an easy-to-read digital gauge, automatic shutoff at a preset pressure, a hose long enough to reach comfortably, useful storage for the cable and accessories, and a realistic duty cycle. If you drive a large SUV or truck, check that the compressor is designed for the required tire volume rather than buying the smallest unit available.

Compare current portable tire inflators on eBay

5. Smart battery charger or maintainer — best for cars that sit unused

If a car, motorcycle or weekend vehicle spends long periods parked, a smart battery maintainer can be more useful than repeatedly jump-starting a weak battery. Modern maintainers monitor the battery and adjust the charging cycle rather than continuously forcing maximum charge into it.

This category is particularly useful for seasonal vehicles, second cars and vehicles with electrical systems that continue drawing a small amount of power while parked. The key is matching the charger to the battery chemistry and voltage.

What to look for: compatibility with your battery type, automatic maintenance or float mode, reverse-polarity protection and weather resistance if the charger will be used in a garage or carport where moisture is possible. Owners of AGM or lithium batteries should check compatibility explicitly rather than assuming every charger supports them.

Compare current smart battery chargers and maintainers on eBay

6. Wireless CarPlay or Android Auto adapter — best convenience upgrade

If your vehicle already has factory wired Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, a small wireless adapter can remove the need to plug your phone in for every journey. For frequent short trips, that can be one of those minor upgrades that quickly becomes difficult to give up.

The important limitation is compatibility: these adapters normally convert an existing wired CarPlay or Android Auto connection to wireless. They do not magically add CarPlay to a vehicle that never supported it in the first place.

What to look for: explicit compatibility with your vehicle and phone, fast automatic reconnection, firmware updates and good return terms in case your particular infotainment system is temperamental. Expect a small connection delay compared with plugging in directly.

Compare current wireless CarPlay and Android Auto adapters on eBay

7. Dual-action car polisher — best for DIY detailing

A dual-action polisher is a worthwhile step up from polishing by hand if you regularly maintain your own paintwork. The oscillating action makes a DA machine more beginner-friendly than a traditional rotary polisher, while still being capable of improving light swirls and restoring gloss when paired with the right pad and compound.

This is one area where buying the cheapest kit can be false economy. A smoother machine with sensible speed control, readily available backing plates and replacement pads is much easier to use over an entire vehicle.

What to look for: variable speed, comfortable weight, a common backing-plate size, replacement pad availability and clear instructions. Start with the least aggressive pad and polish combination required for the job, and test a small area before working across the whole car.

Compare current dual-action car polishers on eBay

What should you buy first?

For an everyday driver, we would prioritize a portable tire inflator and a quality jump starter because both solve common roadside problems and can be useful regardless of how interested you are in cars. A dash cam is the next logical addition if you want a record of incidents on the road.

For anyone who maintains their own vehicle, an OBD2 scanner and smart battery charger can quickly become useful garage tools. The CarPlay adapter and dual-action polisher are more optional, but both can deliver a noticeable improvement if they match how you use and care for your car.

How to get better value on eBay Motors

Compare the exact brand and model rather than sorting purely by the lowest price. Check seller feedback, item location, shipping time, returns and warranty information. For electronic automotive tools, also confirm software-update terms and vehicle compatibility before ordering.

Branded products can be particularly worth comparing across new, open-box and manufacturer-refurbished listings. A modest saving is not worthwhile if the cheaper listing has unclear warranty coverage, missing accessories or an uncertain specification.
